name: Primalist Magma Fissure pierces absorbs and makes the next spell instant (#12302)
contract: #12302 Magma Fissure: the tooltip of every rank (802793, 803826 to 803829) says it deals Fire damage 'piercing
absorption effects' and 'Your next spell within $803299d is instant cast.' Rank 5 803829 is an instant line
attack (TargetA 24) with a SCHOOL_DAMAGE effect, but nothing set SpellInfo::AscensionIgnoreAbsorb for it and
nothing applied 803299 Magma Fissure (Buff), a -100% casting time modifier (aura 108, MiscValue 10): the
passive 707314 that triggers it has no proc flags and is taught by nothing. Expected: a target holding
Hardened Skin 71586 (a 6400 point absorb of every school) takes Magma Fissure's damage with nothing absorbed,
the absorb keeps its full 6400, and the caster gains 803299 right after the cast. The tooltip's sideways
knockback (effect 1, SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT) is not covered here. 803299 has no proc charges in Spell.dbc,
so without a consumer it would make every affected spell for its 6 seconds instant; the tooltip says only the
next spell, so the next affected cast removes it. Geode Barrage rank 8 502775 (2.5 s cast, in 803299's class
mask) checks this: the first cast lands at once and removes the buff, the second one casts normally.

steps.label: fixture: the target shields itself with Hardened Skin
SETUP: the target holds Hardened Skin
SETUP: no instant cast buff before Magma Fissure
SETUP: Magma Fissure hit the target once
Magma Fissure dealt damage through the absorb
DISCRIMINATING: nothing of Magma Fissure was absorbed
DISCRIMINATING: Hardened Skin keeps its full 6400
DISCRIMINATING: the next spell is made instant
Geode Barrage normally has a 2.5 s cast
DISCRIMINATING: Geode Barrage lands at once
DISCRIMINATING: the next spell used up the buff
DISCRIMINATING: the spell after that has its normal cast time
